THREE LIMITS THAT APPLY TO THE ROWS THAT DO PASS.
1  Effects are modest. rho 0.18 for torsion against transcription; AUC 0.72 for cytotoxic
class after confound removal. Real, controlled, and not large.
2  The cancer row is 4/4 and its finding is INVERTED: after removing gene length and
citation count the model predicts NON-drivers at 0.7010, and the loss-of-function
subset it could mechanistically explain sits at 0.5073, which is chance. A gate
boolean cannot carry that; a reader who stops at the column gets it backwards.
3  Nothing here predicts a QUANTITY. Every passing row separates classes -- driver from
not, cytotoxic from not, high torsion from low. None of them says how much.
